rationale: Three long-history sparse/complete-record shifted diagnostics fail after averaging the two registered fits. Together with the preceding ten failed paired-fit shift conditions, these expose missing same-fit native references. Admit exactly six already frozen native second-fit counterparts: artifact, sparse and complete evidence at sixteen episodes with 32768 labels and 256 episodes with 8192 labels. These complete the native-versus-shift attribution comparisons without repeating valid work, introducing settings or adding worlds. Both shifts share each native reference. The measured runnable queue has fallen below a day; these scientifically necessary counterparts restore the day margin. Primary context and the frozen confirmation extension remain separate.
